title: Save is disabled until the schedule has one service
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in as an Owner/Admin, or a user with "Settings Service" enabled, on the build under test. The Maintenance Reminders feature is on for the shop (it ships behind the maintenance_reminders flag).
  2. In the left sidebar under Settings choose "Maintenance" (it sits beneath "Inspection Templates"). Schedules here belong to the location chosen in the header.
  3. A new schedule editor is open (click New schedule).
custom_steps:
1. Read the editor top to bottom (what it contains).
  2. Click the title and try to rename it inline.
  3. Note the Save button state before adding any service, then after adding one service (Add service -> name it -> set an interval -> save the service).
  4. Make a change and press Cancel.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • The editor carries only a name at the top and an ordered list of services beneath it (reminder timing lives on each service, not here).
  • The title reads "Untitled schedule" and edits inline; the editor has Cancel and Save.
  • Save is disabled until at least one service exists, then becomes enabled; name, services and order save only on Save.
  • Cancel discards unsaved changes, asking first when there are any.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-3780 (Maintenance Reminders); story SV-10558 (S1, Create a maintenance schedule); Chunk 1 MR spec (Confluence 886931488), Part 1 / S1; read 29 Sep 2026. Source-verified 29 September 2026; not yet build-verified.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S1-R6: “The editor will carry only a name and an ordered list of services”
  • S1-R7: “The title will read Untitled schedule with inline edit, following the DVI pattern”
  • S1-R8: “The editor will carry Cancel and Save. Save is disabled until the schedule has at least one service. The name, the services and their order are saved only when Save is pressed; Cancel discards every unsaved change, asking first when there are any”
